pretreatment: O2 plasma exposure for 5 min prior to the deposition
evidence: The films were deposited on 4 cm2 native oxide covered monocrystalline Si (100) substrates (p-type, 10– 30 Ω cm) placed on a heated substrate holder (100– 225 °C). The substrates were exposed to an O2 plasma for 5 min prior to the deposition.
